snippet.title: Backyard Soccer (1998) Gameplay
snippet.description:
Backyard Soccer (1998) Gameplay

Backyard Soccer is a Sports game for kids ages 5-10 created by Humongous Entertainment that teaches kids how to play Soccer.  It is the second game in the Backyard Sports series and the first in the Soccer series.
